name: Arcade
author: Christopher Garay
description: Your retro games in the Omarchy bar, each one showing the frame you paused on — plus a fullscreen cover-art grid for browsing the whole library.

barWidget.description: Resume a RetroArch save state from the bar, with the frame you paused on as the thumbnail. Right-click for the fullscreen library.

schema.label: Rescan interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the library is rebuilt in the background. Opening the panel always rescans, so this only affects the count shown in the bar.

schema.label: Maximum library rows
schema.description: Caps rendered rows in the bar panel. Search still looks through the whole library.

schema.label: Watch the RetroArch library for changes
schema.description: Notices playlist imports, save states, and core choices without waiting for the rescan interval.

schema.label: Watch interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the library is checked for changes.
